description: Converge the issue kanban board from a field-by-field literal UI into a scannable surface: contain desktop horizontal scroll to the board region, converge card top-row density, enforce WCAG AA contrast on per-card text and pills, keep a single global sort control, and drive the card color strip from priority.

tasks.title: Add priority-driven strip color map and dedup priority chip colors in shared color lib
tasks.spec: specs/issue-board/spec.md#The card color strip is driven by priority
tasks.description: In shared/lib/label-colors.ts add a new getPriorityStripColor(priority) helper with a deterministic, distinct-per-priority map (P0 red / P1 orange / P2 yellow / P3 green / P4 gray, distinct hues — not reusing PRIORITY_COLORS where p0 and p1 currently collide). Align the existing PRIORITY_COLORS chip map so p0 != p1 for consistency with the new strip map. Keep getStripColor (label-based) untouched as a generic helper. Add a unit test asserting each PRIORITY_COLORS pair meets >=4.5:1 contrast and that getPriorityStripColor returns distinct hues across p0..p4.
acceptanceCriteria: getPriorityStripColor is exported from shared/lib/label-colors.ts and returns distinct hex values for p0, p1, p2, p3, p4 (no two priorities share a hue)
getPriorityStripColor falls back to gray for null/unknown priority
PRIORITY_COLORS chip map no longer has p0 and p1 colliding on the same color
Unit test asserts every PRIORITY_COLORS background/text pair reaches >=4.5:1 contrast
Unit test asserts getPriorityStripColor distinctness across p0..p4
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and the label-colors unit test pass
tasks.output: packages/web/src/shared/lib/label-colors.ts (getPriorityStripColor + deduped PRIORITY_COLORS) with an updated/added label-colors unit test asserting AA contrast and strip-color distinctness
tasks.notes: This is the foundation task: T-004 consumes getPriorityStripColor and the verified chip colors. Do not change getStripColor's contract — only the card call site changes later.

tasks.title: Confine desktop board horizontal scroll via the min-w-0 containment chain
tasks.spec: specs/issue-board/spec.md#Desktop board layout contains its own horizontal scroll
tasks.description: Close the broken flex containment chain above the board row by adding min-w-0 to the three flex ancestors: SidebarInset's <main> (shared/ui/components/sidebar.tsx), the App.tsx content wrapper, and the KanbanBoard.tsx root container. The board row's existing overflow-x-auto then becomes the effective scroll owner, preventing page-level horizontal scroll and left-nav displacement. Add a min-w-0 assertion test mirroring WorkflowSessionsPanel.test.tsx:355 to pin the board-to-shell containment chain in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: min-w-0 is present on SidebarInset <main>, the App.tsx content wrapper, and the KanbanBoard root container
The board row retains its existing overflow-x-auto (scroll owner) and column min-w-[280px] is unchanged
At a 1440px viewport with all four columns present, no whole-page horizontal scrollbar renders and the left navigation stays fixed during board horizontal scroll
A unit test asserts min-w-0 on each link of the board->app-shell containment chain
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and the containment test pass
tasks.output: packages/web/src/shared/ui/components/sidebar.tsx, packages/web/src/app/App.tsx, packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx (min-w-0 additions) with a board-containment assertion test
tasks.notes: Precedent: WorkflowView.tsx and WorkflowSessionsPanel already ship this exact pattern with a regression test. The md/768px mobile branch is untouched (it already confines scroll to its tab strip).

tasks.title: Remove per-column sort controls and keep a single global sort entry
tasks.spec: specs/issue-board/spec.md#The board exposes a single global sort control
tasks.description: Delete the per-column-header sort button group in StageColumn.tsx and drop the sort/onSortChange props from StageColumn's interface. The global SortToggle in the FilterBar (desktop and mobile) remains the single source of truth driving the shared BoardQueryState.sort. Update kanban-board-query tests to assert no per-column sort buttons render and that the single global SortToggle drives sort for all columns.
acceptanceCriteria: StageColumn no longer renders a sort button group and its interface no longer accepts sort/onSortChange props
KanbanBoard no longer passes sort state/handlers into StageColumn
Exactly one SortToggle remains, located in the top filter bar (present in both desktop and mobile layouts)
Tests assert no per-column sort button group is rendered and that changing the global sort drives all columns
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and the updated board-query tests pass
tasks.output: packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/StageColumn.tsx and packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/KanbanBoard.tsx (sort prop removal) with updated kanban-board-query tests
tasks.notes: Both the column group and the global toggle currently mutate the same BoardQueryState.sort, so the column group is pure redundancy. Mobile has no column headers, so the global toggle must be the survivor.

tasks.title: Converge IssueCard top-row density, enforce AA text contrast, and switch strip to priority
tasks.description: In IssueCard.tsx: (1) remove the always-visible workflow-profile chip and expose its value only via a title hover hint on the issue-number span (or card root), keeping data-testid/data-workflow-profile hooks on a hidden/aria node so tests can assert hover availability; (2) when a status pill (Running/Approval/Blocked/Drift) renders, fold the stage label and progress numbers into that pill (e.g. 'Running · Build 2/5') instead of rendering an independent WorkflowStagePill + standalone progress unit — when no status pill renders, the stage pill may still render standalone; (3) raise auxiliary text (issue number, timestamp) from text-muted-foreground/70 to full-opacity text-muted-foreground for AA; (4) audit each StatusPill variant pair and adjust any below 4.5:1; (5) change the left strip call site from getStripColor(issue.labels) to getPriorityStripColor(issue.priority). Update IssueCard.test.tsx to assert the converged top row, stage-fold format, hover-only profile, priority-driven strip, and StatusPill AA contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Default (non-hovered) card top row shows only issue number, priority indicator, and at most one status pill; the full workflow-profile string is not visible as text
Workflow-profile value is available via a title hover hint and remains inspectable; data hooks are preserved for tests
When a status pill renders, no independent second stage pill is rendered alongside it; stage info folds into the status pill with progress as part of the label (e.g. 'Running · Build 2/5')
Issue number and timestamp use full-opacity muted-foreground token (>=4.5:1 contrast)
Every StatusPill variant background/text pair reaches >=4.5:1 contrast, asserted by a unit test
Left color strip color is derived from getPriorityStripColor(issue.priority), not from labels
IssueCard.test.tsx asserts the converged top row, stage-fold format, hover-only profile, priority strip, and StatusPill AA contrast
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and IssueCard tests pass
tasks.output: packages/web/src/widgets/kanban-board/ui/IssueCard.tsx (converged top row, AA text, priority strip) with updated IssueCard.test.tsx
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 for getPriorityStripColor and the deduped/verified PRIORITY_COLORS. Fold stage at render time only — do not touch getStatusIndicator derivation logic (visual-layer-only Non-Goal). Prefer darkening text over backgrounds to keep the soft-tint aesthetic. Stage-fold label format is pinned as 'Running · Build 2/5' (status-first).

tasks.title: Verify desktop and mobile regression of all board behaviors after convergence
tasks.spec: specs/issue-board/spec.md#Existing board behaviors remain functional across desktop and mobile layouts
tasks.description: Run the full packages/web typecheck and test suite and perform a desktop+mobile regression pass confirming the convergence did not break existing behaviors: filtering, sorting (via the single global control), Done-column collapse, Show/Hide cancelled, Archive and Archive-all-done, and the Needs-Attention banner — at both a 1440px desktop width and a <768px mobile width. Confirm no whole-page horizontal scroll at desktop and that the left nav stays fixed.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes with zero errors
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes with zero failures
Filtering, sorting, Done-column collapse, Show/Hide cancelled, Archive / Archive-all-done, and the Needs-Attention banner each function correctly on the desktop layout
The same set of interactions each function correctly on the mobile (<768px) layout
No whole-page horizontal scrollbar appears at 1440px; left navigation remains fixed during board horizontal scroll
tasks.output: Green typecheck + test:run for packages/web plus a completed desktop/mobile regression checklist confirming all core interactions remain functional
tasks.notes: This is the cross-cutting integration verification for the 'existing behaviors remain functional' requirement, which spans all four implementation tasks and cannot be owned by any single one. Each implementation task already owns its own unit/spec tests; this task verifies the integrated whole.
